shortDescription.default: Living documentation and engineering dashboard for SharePoint-based app builds.

longDescription.default: Tech Elixir Solution Center is a SharePoint Framework web part that serves as a living documentation and application engineering dashboard for SharePoint-based app builds, including Finance Elixir, Fitness Elixir, Script Elixir, and other Tech Elixir projects.
